description: Phase A production-hardening (ROADMAP.md Phase A; prd-pinakes-deep-history-roadmap.md §"Not yet hardened"). `bun run check` (tsc over web/ + contracts) carries ~145 pre-existing TypeScript errors from the pre-cutover era. The verify hook's TS check is a hard gate today (see .chief/verify.sh header), so this legacy baseline is dead weight. Drive the 145 errors to zero so `bun run check` is a real, clean gate on every future client change. Scope: web/ client TS, contracts consumers, and scripts/ where check:scripts overlaps — no behavior change, types only. Serializes with other client work on the `client` domain.

userStories.title: Drive `bun run check` to zero errors
userStories.description: Fix the ~145 pre-existing tsc errors under web/ + contracts so the hard-gated typecheck passes clean, without changing runtime behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `bun run check` (tsc -p web/tsconfig.json) reports zero errors; the fixes are type-only (no behavior change) and do not weaken config by disabling strictness wholesale or blanket `// @ts-ignore`.
`bun run check:scripts` (scripts/ has its own tsconfig) is also clean.
`bun run test` (vitest) stays green — no test was broken to satisfy the typechecker.

userStories.title: Keep the gate clean going forward
userStories.description: Ensure the now-clean typecheck stays a real hard gate — no reintroduced baseline, contract bindings still consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: `bun run check:contracts` passes (generated bindings consistent) if any contract consumer was touched, and `bun run check:registry-mirror` passes if a registry-shaped file changed.
The .chief/verify.sh TS check needs no baseline-diff shim (it can stay the hard gate its header describes); a note records that the legacy baseline is retired.
